taxonomy_note: Primary categories are UI organization, not mutually exclusive musical laws. Texture includes timbre, harmony, register, and articulation because the requested taxonomy has no separate Harmony category.
provenance_note: Source-observed means the word or normalized musical concept was present in a reviewed source, not proven effective in Suno. Author-expansion means an independently curated addition, not a claim of novelty or absence from Suno.
weight_meaning: Symmetric estimated musical affinity for tag discovery and relative attraction. Not a probability, popularity score, Suno parameter, measured co-occurrence, embedding similarity, or audio-quality score.
missing_pair_policy: Return default_weight 0.20. Missing means unscored, not measured weak or incompatible.
storage_policy: Every unordered explicit pair is stored once under the case-insensitive alphabetically earlier label. Every canonical term remains an outer key, even if its object is empty.
